blind.description: A low stack or cluster of floor cushions and pillows. At the bottom are two overlapping dark burgundy/plum tufted cushions equipped with small rounded black feet. Resting on top of them is an assortment of cushions: a round olive-green tufted cushion, a cylindrical brown bolster pillow, a smaller brownish square pillow with a corner tassel, and a cream-colored square throw pillow placed atop the pile. All fabric surfaces appear soft, continuous, and fully modeled with no floating or shattered geometry.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a compact arrangement of layered cushions: a dark rectangular base partly visible beneath a round dark-green cushion, a light cream square pillow, and brown rectangular and bolster pillows.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.5 ft tall) and roughly half its height in width (around 2.5 to 3 ft wide).

notes: Footprint is roughly square (3.0 x 2.9 ft) rather than rectangular (3.0 x 2.0 ft)
